candidate.blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12: administer parenteral medications safely, identify adverse effects, monitor medication response, and intervene for complications.
candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — ferumoxytol infusion hypersensitivity precautions
candidate.educational_objective: Administer ferumoxytol over at least 15 minutes with emergency treatment available and observe for hypersensitivity during and for at least 30 minutes after each infusion.

options.A: Administer as an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes with anaphylaxis treatment immediately available, and observe during and for at least 30 minutes afterward.
options.B: Skip post-infusion observation when a previous ferumoxytol dose was tolerated without any adverse reaction.
options.C: Give the entire dose by rapid IV push because faster administration lowers hypersensitivity risk.
options.D: Monitor only for hypoglycemia because serious hypersensitivity is not a labeled ferumoxytol risk.

candidate.rationale: The May 31, 2026 Feraheme label carries a boxed warning for serious hypersensitivity and anaphylaxis. It requires IV infusion over at least 15 minutes when personnel and therapies are immediately available to treat anaphylaxis, and observation for hypersensitivity during and for at least 30 minutes after the infusion, including blood-pressure and pulse monitoring. Reactions can occur even when a previous dose was tolerated. A is correct.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Ferumoxytol must be administered as an IV infusion over at least 15 minutes with anaphylaxis treatment available and requires hypersensitivity observation during and for at least 30 minutes after infusion.
candidate.source_locator: Boxed Warning; §2 Dosage and Administration; §5.1 Serious Hypersensitivity Reactions: infusion over at least 15 minutes; personnel/therapies immediately available; observe during and at least 30 minutes afterward with blood pressure and pulse monitoring; reactions can occur after previously tolerated doses.
candidate.source_organization: DailyMed / U.S. National Library of Medicine official drug label
candidate.stem: A client is receiving intravenous ferumoxytol for iron-deficiency anemia. Which safety measure is required by the current product label?
